description: Bo and Tate stay on the move as her powers grow stronger and Orchestra intensifies its pursuit, while the people they meet repeatedly pull Bo toward using her abilities despite the risk of being found.

s01e01.description: Ten-year-old Bo’s growing supernatural abilities place her in danger, and her protectors entrust her to Tate, a wrongfully imprisoned man who becomes her reluctant guardian.

s01e02.description: Short of money in Atlantic City, Tate and Bo become involved with a struggling mother and sick child while the FBI and Skouras close in.

s01e03.description: Trapped in Manhattan, Bo and Tate encounter a wealthy woman still grieving the disappearance of her son decades earlier.

s01e04.description: As the search tightens around them, Tate risks his freedom to help Bo trace a long-lost love letter while Winter prepares an escape from Manhattan.

s01e05.description: In Philadelphia, Bo is drawn to a couple whose marriage is being damaged by the husband’s pursuit of a mysterious story, while Skouras hunts a traitor.

s01e06.description: Tate returns home to confront the childhood friends who framed him for murder, while Skouras studies the potential of a young telepath.

s01e07.description: After a dangerous confrontation leaves Bo vulnerable, Winter turns to old guardians for protection while Skouras pushes another gifted subject too far.

s01e08.description: Bo uses her powers to help a police officer suspected in a young woman’s disappearance and discovers that he has abilities similar to her own.

s01e09.description: Winter sends Channing inside Orchestra to learn how Skouras is tracking Bo, while Bo ignores orders to keep a low profile and helps a desperate family man.

s01e10.description: Bo foresees a young musical prodigy dying in a car crash and diverts Tate from her training, while Winter reacts to Channing’s capture.

s01e11.description: Bo foresees a deadly subway disaster and convinces Tate to intervene, only for an explosion to trap them underground with Agent Ferrell.

s01e12.description: While Winter struggles to save Channing, Bo and Tate confront Skouras directly and demand that he stop pursuing them.

s01e13.description: Dani turns her powers against Orchestra and Bo, forcing former enemies into an uneasy alliance as Bo’s visions pull her and Tate back into danger.
